title: Best Surround Sound System (2026)
summary: The guide highlights four surround sound systems, with the JBL Bar 9.1 leading as the top choice for most buyers.
method: Selections were based on the products mentioned in the cited sources (PCMag, TechRadar, CNET, Tom’s Guide, and Home Theater Academy).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

products.name: JBL Bar 9.1 Channel Soundbar System with Dolby Atmos
why: The JBL Bar 9.1 offers 820 W output power and built‑in Dolby Atmos and DTS:X decoding.
It includes detachable, battery‑powered surround speakers and a 300 W, 10‑inch subwoofer for deep bass.
products.desc: The JBL Bar 9.1 is a 9.1‑channel soundbar system that includes detachable battery‑powered speakers, a 300 W subwoofer, and supports Dolby Atmos and DTS:X. It does not include wired surround speakers.
products.benefit: Picture a family movie night where every sound feels like it’s coming from all around you. The JBL Bar 9.1 delivers 820 W of power, Dolby Atmos and DTS:X decoding, and detachable battery‑powered speakers for true 9.1 channel surround. It’s ideal for anyone who wants a cinematic experience without a full speaker rack. The catch: the detachable speakers are battery‑powered, so you’ll need to recharge them.
products.best_for: Home theater enthusiasts who want a cinematic experience without a full speaker rack
products.skip_if: You need a fully wired surround setup

products.name: VIZIO 5.1
why: The VIZIO 5.1 is highlighted as a great sound under $300.
It offers a 5.1 channel surround setup.
products.desc: The VIZIO 5.1 is a 5.1 channel surround sound system that provides a budget-friendly option for home theater audio.
products.benefit: Picture a casual movie night where you want clear dialogue and immersive sound without breaking the bank. The VIZIO 5.1 delivers a full 5.1 channel surround experience at a price under $300, making it a solid choice for budget-conscious buyers. The catch: it lacks advanced features like Dolby Atmos decoding.
products.best_for: Budget-conscious buyers who want a full surround experience
products.skip_if: You need Dolby Atmos or higher-end features

products.name: VIZIO 2.1
why: The VIZIO 2.1 is listed as the best budget soundbar in the CNET guide.
products.desc: The VIZIO 2.1 is a 2.1 channel soundbar that provides a budget-friendly option for improving TV audio.
products.benefit: Picture a small living room where you want better TV sound without a full speaker setup. The VIZIO 2.1 offers a 2.1 channel soundbar that improves dialogue clarity and adds bass, making it a great choice for compact spaces. The catch: it only provides 2.1 channels, so it lacks full surround immersion.
products.best_for: Small rooms or budget buyers who need better TV sound
products.skip_if: You want full surround or advanced features
